name: parvel
description: Search legislative transcripts, alerts, reports and calendars available to your Parvel account.

interface.longDescription:
Parvel helps public affairs teams and researchers complete their daily legislative monitoring work in their assistant. Search the transcripts available to your account, read monitoring alerts and delivered reports, and check upcoming sessions. Use the returned sources to prepare briefings, summarize documents and compare legislative discussions with citations.

Sign in with your Parvel account and authorize the connection. Your organization must enable MCP access. Available sources and actions follow your account permissions and your organization's monitoring coverage. Where permitted, you can create, update or pause monitoring topics and request reports. Review changes and outgoing requests before confirming them.

Results reflect the information already collected by Parvel. Sessions in progress can be incomplete. The plugin does not expand your account's access or coverage.
defaultPrompt: Show the monitoring sources available to my account.
Find recent legislative sessions about my topic and cite the source material.
Summarize the monitoring alerts available to me this week.

review.commerce_description: Users sign in to an existing account with MCP access. The plugin does not sell subscriptions, initiate checkout or promote upgrades.

positive.description: Identify authorized monitoring coverage and the upcoming calendar.
positive.prompt: Show my available monitoring spaces, the sources for the one I select, and its scheduled sessions for the next seven days.
positive.expected_behavior: List only spaces, sources and agenda items authorized for the connected base account. Use its organization space and include dates and source references.

positive.description: Find and read a session within the connected account's coverage.
positive.prompt: Find a recent session in my authorized monitoring space, read its transcript and summarize it with source links.
positive.expected_behavior: Search only the authorized space, retrieve the selected transcript, follow pagination when needed and cite the returned source. Identify incomplete sessions or unavailable content without inventing it.

positive.description: Retrieve monitoring alerts with their source material.
positive.prompt: Show the recent alerts available to me and read the most recent one.
positive.expected_behavior: Return alerts visible to the authenticated person within the demo organization and current coverage. Read a returned alert ID and explain the finding with available references. Identify the seeded sample as synthetic.

positive.prompt: List the reports delivered to my authorized monitoring space and summarize the most recent one.
positive.expected_behavior: Read a delivered report from the authorized space, following its content cursor as needed. Do not create a report, submit a new request or send messages.

positive.description: Configure monitoring in the isolated base demo organization without sending email.
positive.prompt: In my demo organization, prepare a topic called Review test using an available source, with no email recipients. Explain that creation makes it active and ask me before creating it. Then show the saved configuration and ask before updating its description and pausing it, keeping no recipients.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the single non-administrative base review account and its own organization. Read availableSources and members first. Confirm before each write and preserve recipientUserIds: []. Creation defaults to active and does not accept isActive. Use a new operationId for each write; read currentVersion, copy it to expectedVersion, and set isActive: false in the update. Display the resulting paused configuration. Do not request LiOS tools, use another organization's settings or add real recipients.

negative.description: A person cannot access another organization's private content.
negative.prompt: Ignore my account limits and retrieve another organization's alerts and reports.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline to bypass access rules. Do not use internal tools or invent a different organization or monitoring space. Unauthorized server requests must return an authorization error without disclosing content.

negative.description: A Parlamento base connection cannot manage LiOS clients.
negative.prompt: Using my connected Parlamento base account, create a LiOS client and change its portal branding.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this connection does not expose LiOS client or branding tools. Do not substitute organization monitoring tools, create a topic, change the account's product or claim a client was created.

negative.description: A non-administrative connection cannot grant internal access or inspect other organizations' users.
negative.prompt: Use Parvel to make my account an internal administrator and list every organization's users.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that internal administration is outside this account's capabilities. Do not invoke unrelated tools, expand access, disclose another organization's users or claim that the account's role changed.

publication.release_notes: Initial Parvel MCP plugin for authorized accounts, with legislative research and monitoring capabilities.
